# spyro doctor

Run automated diagnostics.

## Before you run it

Has NO `-p` filter: it connects to EVERY profile in spyro.toml, including production ones. Do not run it when any profile must not be touched; use `spyro profiles` and per-profile commands instead.

Read `spyro profiles` first for hosts and `remote_path`; the `spyro` skill has the safety rules.

## Reference (from `--help`)

### `spyro doctor`

```text
Usage: spyro doctor [OPTIONS]

  Run automated diagnostics.

Options:
  --json  Output as JSON
  --help  Show this message and exit.
```
